chart.levels.description: Level settings for every chart, applied live. Shape: {"sources": {SOURCE: bool (default true)}, "levels": {KEY: {"on": bool, "color": mist|t2|up|down|brass|teal, "line": solid|dash|dot, "label": name|short|none, "distance": bool}}}. KEY is a level's key, `<source>.<package>.<field>` with the vendor's field verbatim (acme.classic.zero_gamma, acme.classic.major_pos_vol, acme.state.major_long_gamma, tessera.concepts.pdh); SOURCE is a key's first two parts (acme.classic, acme.state, tessera.concepts, a source added from a spec). intel.list_sources lists every source's keys and default styles. A level's fields override its defaults; set the whole object (read it first with settings_get).
